summary: Compose the N3 DCX/halo marker-initialization slice in source order: beam-grid cell position, caller plasma snapshot, thermal-species selection, thermal Maxwellian halo velocity, caller level-resolved CX rates, and the collisional-radiative initial-state weighting.

identity.relation: Source-ordered non-interchangeable composition: cell_position -> local_plasma -> thermal_species_selection -> halo_velocity -> cx_rate -> initial_state. The position is sampled from the caller's cell and uniform draws; the plasma provider is invoked at the sampled position; the species mass is selected; the halo velocity is sampled from the plasma snapshot and caller normal draws; the CX-rate provider is invoked at the sampled position and velocity; the initial state weights those rates with the selected source density and isotope correction.
identity.direction: beam-grid cell + caller uniform/normal draws + two caller provider callables (plasma snapshot, level-resolved CX rates) + species index + beam mass + fast-ion density + energy conversion -> sampled position, plasma snapshot, halo velocity and thermal speed, CX rates, and the colrad initial-state weighting
identity.definition: The saved FIDASIM DCXHalo标记初态图 TaskGraph (framework node N3 neutral_population_transport; source order mc_beam_grid -> get_plasma -> mc_halo -> track/get_total_cx_rate -> states per src/fidasim.f90:12649-12663, 12763-12778, 13172-13182, 13337-13355), composed from integrated SciRel leaves. The two provider callables are explicit caller capabilities (get_plasma and get_total_cx_rate state); the graph does not cache callback results as hidden state and does not reverse-derive position or velocity from the states.
identity.model: composition of the named SciRel leaves following the saved graph's node/edge contract; no new scientific rule is introduced in glue
identity.geometry: one marker in one declared Cartesian beam-grid cell
identity.coordinates: positions and velocities in cm and cm/s, temperature in keV, masses in amu, rates in s^-1, densities in cm^-3
identity.boundary: caller-owned RNG algorithm and continuation (the graph consumes only explicit draws); provider callables own plasma lookup and CX-rate reduction state; colrad advancement, neutral-reservoir updates, photon storage and MPI reduction stay outside; provider contract violations fail closed (registered: ValueError with declared missing fields, replacing the saved arm's raw TypeError/KeyError)
assumptions: The plasma provider returns the declared finite fields for the sampled position.
The CX-rate provider returns finite nonnegative level-resolved rates for the sampled position and velocity.

preconditions: Caller-owned explicit draws and the two provider capabilities with the declared contracts.
supported: One marker's source-ordered DCX/halo initialization up to the colrad initial state.
excluded: colrad time advancement, track geometry, get_total_cx_rate state, neutral-reservoir updates, photon storage, MPI reduction and full DCX/halo Monte-Carlo parity.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError when inputs is not a mapping or a required key is missing, when either provider is not callable, when the plasma snapshot is not a mapping or misses a declared field, or when the CX rates are not finite nonnegative.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Propagates the composed leaves' fail-closed ValueError contracts (cell sampling, halo sampling, species selection, initial-state weighting).
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; each node executes once in source order.

nodes.description: Sample the marker position inside the caller's cell from the uniform draws.
Invoke the caller plasma provider at the sampled position; the snapshot is passed through without hidden caching.
Select the declared thermal-ion mass for the source species loop.
Sample the thermal Maxwellian halo velocity from the plasma snapshot and the caller normal draws.
Invoke the caller CX-rate provider at the sampled position and halo velocity; the rate receipt is passed through without hidden caching.
Weight the level-resolved CX rates into the colrad initial state with the selected source density and isotope correction.
Assemble the graph-order diagnostics; no scientific transformation.

execution.ordering: Run the six nodes strictly in the source order cell_position -> local_plasma -> thermal_species_selection -> halo_velocity -> cx_rate -> initial_state; each node executes exactly once and the two provider callables are invoked only at their declared source positions (plasma after the sampled position, CX rates after position and velocity).
branches: No branches: single source-ordered path; the eligible flag reports marker processability instead of branching.
Any provider contract violation or leaf failure raises ValueError without partial results.
execution.state_ownership: The graph owns no evolving state; RNG algorithms and continuation, get_plasma and get_total_cx_rate state, and track geometry are caller-owned capabilities.
execution.failure_propagation: Provider and leaf ValueError contracts propagate directly; there is no fallback sampling or partial marker state.

example.description: The saved marker flow on a symmetric cell with zero rotation and zero normal draws: position at the cell center, zero halo velocity, and the initial state equal to the direct leaf call.
